status: Measured controller correction; not historical death apportionment or demonstrated survival improvement

method.observation: Read-only hooks before funded stationary gathering, actual extraction, cancellation and the measured metabolic interval. Empty means <=1e-9 kg; after-start requires a matching pending experience and a strictly later dated personal observation. Full final world digest must match an uninstrumented reference. Actual stock is read by diagnostics only, never substituted into a decision.
method.sourceHash: Sorted Git-visible src path + NUL + bytes + NUL.
method.baselineReuse: Before uses the previously completed uninstrumented care-planning day; after has a new uninstrumented reference under the strictly later observation rule.
method.privacy: Full inhabited save, actor traces and generated diagnostic bundles remain private; aggregate measurements and exact fingerprints are retained here.

controlledCases: Fresh local empty observation interrupts a paid plan without refund, product or same-interval replacement work; stale rich memory continues.
A 0.5 kg observed positive source remains physically harvestable.
A freshly observed exhausted stone source ends extraction conservatively.
An older or same-interval empty memory does not veto a deliberately new attempt.
Hidden distant depletion cannot change route, position or RNG.
Saved task, personal observation and pending experience load unchanged before ordinary reconsideration.
limits: One 24-hour current-law counterfactual from inherited oversized infants and initially empty migrated intake. No independent historical death share, steady-state food requirement or seasonal viability conclusion.
More aggregate harvest does not imply equal benefit: Amber Hollow harvest falls and aggregate child cold injury rises. Recovery and other health changes are separate from summed metabolic loss.
Most zero-yield completions lack a strictly later empty observation; competition, observation frequency, site learning and batch timing remain unresolved.
Gathered products are still paid only at completion. Cancelled progress has no material product and is not refunded; part predates the opening checkpoint.
Controller convention, bounded memory and no learned site-specific yield. No general gathering-network activation integration or unlimited information.
Relative elemental residual is bounded; no closed total-energy ledger or physical calibration is claimed.
Concurrent local tasks differ; elapsed time and process RSS are not a controlled speed comparison or live combined-memory guarantee.
